The proposed answer has the wrong sign, so it is incorrect.

The denominator factors as (x−1)(x−2)(x−3), so f has simple poles at 1, 2 and 3. The numerator (2025+x)ln(2025+x) is analytic for x > −2025, so these poles are the only nearby singularities.

Near a simple pole at x = a with residue r, f(x) ≈ r/(x−a). Expanding about 0 gives r/(x−a) = −(r/a)·1/(1−x/a) = −r Σ xⁿ/aⁿ⁺¹. So the pole at a contributes −r/aⁿ⁺¹ to dₙ. The proposed solution drops this minus sign.

The residue at x = 1 is 2026 ln 2026 / ((1−2)(1−3)) = 1013 ln 2026, as the solution found. The contributions from the poles at 2 and 3 decay like 2⁻ⁿ and 3⁻ⁿ, and the remainder of f is analytic in a much larger disk, so its coefficients also vanish. Therefore

lim dₙ = −1013 ln 2026 ≈ −7712.8.

The proposed answer, +1013 ln 2026, has the opposite sign.

VERDICT: REJECT
